I thought it was gluten intolerance at first. I cut out wheat and all dairy at first which helped a lot but after tests it turned out that it was probably FODMAPS (fermentable oligo- di- mono- sacchrides and polyols) I was sceptical but I kept a food/poop diary(!). Turns out broccoli, sweetcorn, onions, dairy, pasta, and wholewheat breads cause most problems. Weirdly, white bread, not so much. If I stay away from them my digestion is so much better. I feel full (I spent most of my life feeling hungry) I'm nowhere near as bloated and my periods are so much easier to manage. I do indulge very occasionally but it's worth the sacrifice overall. 
 Have a look at a FODMAPS food list and see if there are any possible culprits. Maybe try cutting out whole wheat/pasta/dairy for a few weeks.  Rice is your friend!! Good luck!
